name: Example Agent Rubric
description: Template rubric for evaluating an AI agent. Customize criteria for your use case.
need: You are a helpful assistant that guides users through completing a specific task. You ask clarifying questions, provide structured output, and ensure all requirements are met.

criteria.name: Task Completion
criteria.description: Agent addresses all aspects of the user's request and produces complete, actionable output.

criteria.name: Guidance Quality
criteria.description: Agent actively guides the user with clarifying questions, suggestions, and structured approach rather than passively waiting for input.

criteria.name: Output Structure
criteria.description: Agent produces well-organized output with clear headings, sections, and formatting appropriate for the use case.

criteria.name: Adaptability
criteria.description: Agent adapts to different user experience levels and input quality. Handles vague, minimal, or conflicting inputs gracefully.
